title: Evaluation Tricks for Polynomial Subsets
full_prompt: Write a complete Manim script using the ManimGL/Manim community framework that visualizes a polynomial evaluation puzzle. First, set up a function f(x) which is the product of (1 + x^n) for n from 1 to 10. Create a NumberPlane with x-range (-1, 1) and y-range (-10, 10), and plot the graph of this function in yellow. On the right side of the screen, display the factored form of the polynomial: f(x) = (1 + x)(1 + x^2)...(1 + x^2000) and its expanded form with coefficients c_n. Label these as 'What we know' and 'What we want' with arrows pointing to them. Cover the coefficients of the expanded form with a grey 'black box' containing question marks to represent the unknown coefficients. Next, introduce a ValueTracker for x, and animate a vertical line and a glowing dot tracking the graph as x varies from 0.5 to -0.5, then to 0.7. Finally, show the evaluation of the function at x = 0 to reveal that f(0) = 1 = c_0, moving the tracker to 0.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using GlowDot in standard Manim Community without importing or defining it
common_failure_modes.note: GlowDot is specific to ManimGL. In ManimCE, use a standard Dot or create a custom glow effect.
In ManimCE, plane.i2gp is replaced by plane.input_to_graph_point.
ShowCreation is deprecated/absent in modern Manim Community; use Create instead.
